payload.text: By eye in the example app: the footer holds the quiet-lines toggle, the label naming the example's log and the command running, and Copy All; after a relaunch the toggle is as it was left and the window opens where it was left; and closing the window adds the example's note. A theme's appearance is the window's, as Gtools.app's console shows, dark whatever the system's mode. README, CHANGELOG and design.md say what was added.
